description: Panoramic view of the old town of Bern from Rosengarten.  This view includes the main landmarks like the Bern Minster, the Bundeshaus (Federal Palace of Switzerland) and the Aare river.  This is a panorama in cylindrical projection fused from two exposure layers and 31 images each.
creator: Daniel Kraft
